twins.title: Selkirk Tangiers — 3-Day Classic · Bell 212
twins.description:
The package that makes the trip: three days of unlimited vertical in the Selkirk & Monashee mountains, out of town since 1978, with everything handled.

**9,000 m guaranteed**, unlimited metres included — the Bell 212 takes up to 10 guests (2–3 groups per aircraft), so our group of 3 fits easily with room to spread out.

Ski days Sun–Tue (Feb 21–23), check-in Saturday Feb 20, **4 nights at the Coast Hillcrest Hotel, all meals included**. ACMG/IFMGA guides, powder ski & snowboard fleet, avalanche airbags + safety gear, Acera emergency medical cover.

**Price: $8,469 CAD + 5% tax ≈ €5,880 pp** in the Feb window (Jan 31 – Mar 6 rate). Availability confirmed for our dates — 35% deposit secures.

twins.title: OPTION — Ski touring at Rogers Pass (guided)
twins.description:
Spontaneous idea from the Rogers Pass guide — **45 min from Revelstoke**, right on our Banff→Revelstoke / Revelstoke→Golden loop. A perfect flex-day use before the heli block.

**What:** guided intro day at Rogers Pass (Glacier National Park) — ancient forests, alpine bowls & couloirs. Terrain is *advanced/expert* with big climbs, so we go with an **ACMG-certified guide** (mixed ski/splitboard OK — Niko on splitboard).

**Logistics:** ~65 km from Revelstoke via Trans-Canada (Hwy 1). Park at Rogers Pass Discovery Centre / dedicated winter lots. Same road that carries the avalanche artillery — respect closures.

**Be ready for:**
- **Winter Permit mandatory** (all zones since 2026, even "unrestricted") — daily permit only at Summit Station or annual online
- **Parks Canada pass** required
- **Avalanche bulletin** (avalanche.ca) + **Rogers Pass interactive map** status (updated ~07:00, lots closed until then) — check before driving
- Full touring kit: splitboard + skins / skis + skins, beacon/probe/shovel (+ airbag as for heli)

Decide with the guide the morning-of based on avy hazard & what's open. *Alternative:* keep the RMR lift day — this block is the "decide-on-the-hill" option.

twins.title: Canada Heliski + Resort Trip
twins.subtitle: BC Powder Highway · Sunshine → Revelstoke → 3 heli days → Kicking Horse → Lake Louise
twins.summary:
16 days, 3 riders (**Niko** — snowboard, **Nick Geelen**, **Stefan De Pauw** — skis), ~10.5–11 ski days across four big resorts **plus 3 heli days with Selkirk Tangiers**. The heli block (Feb 20–24, Coast Hillcrest) is the fixed anchor; everything else is a condition-chasing loop: Sunshine first (arrival-day resort, 2h from Calgary), then Revelstoke (biggest lift-served vertical in North America), the STHS heli, then Kicking Horse and Lake Louise.

**Booked**: flights BRU↔YYC (€1,005.81 pp, booking 9GMOL3) · STHS 3-Day Classic deposit paid ($2,964.15 CAD, 35%) · group locked at 3 · family room confirmed.

**Flex by design**: Day 3 is a *decide-on-the-hill* day, Day 10's KH afternoon is a skippable buffer, and Mar 1 flexes between a Lake Louise morning and a relaxed drive home. Heli down days (STHS averages 2–3/month) fall back to Revelstoke Mountain Resort.
